headline: Reporting Analyst | SQL, Power BI and Excel | Telecom and logistics reporting | Melbourne
about:
I build the dashboards and month end reports that regional managers use to track churn and retention, and I check the data before anyone makes a decision with it.

At Northwind Telecom I built 14 Power BI dashboards and rewrote the month end SQL scripts, cutting report preparation from three days to four hours. At Harbourline Logistics I automated 22 weekly Excel reports with Python.

I'm open to reporting and data analyst roles in Melbourne.
